messages.author: 4fdc04b06b76c8cf
messages.subject: reshape - reshape2 problem
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to use the reshape2 package for melting datasets.

The problem is that I've also loaded the gglot2 package which
automatically loads the reshape-package. And the reshape is
masking my reshape2.

Thats why I tried
reshape2::melt(df_test,id=c("X1", "X2"),variable.name="variable_test",value.name="value.test")

But with no sucess. I still get the results from the melt function in reshape (variable.name
is ignored as a parameter). How can I access the melt function of reshape2 with
having ggplot2 still loaded?

/Johannes

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: reshape - reshape2 problem
parts:
Have you tried loading reshape2 after ggplot2 and all it's requirements? Usually whatever is loaded last masks earlier loaded packages with functions of the same name so if reshape2 is last then it should mask reshape(1) and all of it's similarly named functions. 

Brandon
On Thu, Nov 10, 2011 at 08:30, Johannes Radinger <JRad...@gmx.at> wrote:

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: reshape - reshape2 problem
parts:
I had the same issue. The problem is that melt will call a method. The
method will dispach melt.data.frame from reshape package, thus
ignoring reshape2. The solution is to call specificly
reshape2::melt.data.frame()

HTH
Luciano
